name: Mutate
description: Write variation clips from the selected MIDI clip on a ticked track. Same math as the Mutate MIDI Tool.

fields.label: How many variations (1-16)
fields.hint: How many variation clips to generate from the source clip (max 16).

fields.label: Drop notes (0-1)
fields.hint: Probability to randomly remove notes (0 = none removed, 1 = all removed). Try 0.1.

fields.label: Swap pitches (0-1)
fields.hint: Probability to swap note pitches around (0 = no swaps, 1 = all swapped). Try 0.2.

fields.label: Velocity wobble (0-40)
fields.hint: How much to randomly vary MIDI velocity per note (0 = none, 40 = a lot).

fields.label: Timing wobble in beats (0-0.25)
fields.hint: Max timing randomization in beats (0 = tight, 0.05 = slight groove, 0.25 = loose).

fields.label: Mode: independent or cumulative
fields.hint: independent = each variation starts from the original clip. cumulative = each variation builds on the previous.

fields.label: Seed
fields.hint: Random seed — change this number to get a completely different set of variations.
